description: Aggregate figure inputs exported without raw participant observations. Existing means and intervals are unchanged. Source files remain in the original archived analysis repository.
frozen_interval_method: 95% whole-participant bootstrap, stratified by country and wave; 4000 draws with shared weights across overlapping evaluation splits; fixed models and targets.
prediction_shift_method: One held-out-fold prediction per target; equal average over 25 targets and three seeds; conditional over allocations 0-20; no confidence intervals.
